_comment: Machine-readable application profile for the daily job pipeline. Built 2026-09-02 from the vault (wiki/felix-resume.md, wiki/cmu-coursework-record.md, wiki/application-essay-response-bank.md) and the current resume.tex. Every value traces to those sources; unknowns are null and listed in `missing`. NO credentials live here — ATS passwords stay in ~/zylos/.env. Free-text answers live in answer-bank.md, not here.
_sources: vault wiki/felix-resume.md (Contact, Job-Application Playbook, Education, Experience, Projects)
my_resume resume.tex main branch (résumé wording, dates, coursework line)

email.primary_note: The ONLY address to use on applications — the pipeline reads this inbox over IMAP for verification codes and confirmations.
email.email_alt_note: CMU address. Do NOT use on applications: no IMAP access, so verification codes and confirmations are unreachable (4 UNVERIFIED rows on 2026-09-01 came from this). Use only if a form explicitly demands a .edu address, and then log it as a blocker.

address.county_note: Some forms want the county or 'Orange County' as city — city of residence is Irvine.

links.website_note: Portfolio site. Use for any 'website / portfolio / other URL' field.

education.field_of_study_note: Pick the exact 'Artificial Intelligence' entry when it exists; otherwise the nearest listed fallback in order. Always append a line in the ledger saying which fallback was used.
education.gpa_rules: Free numeric field → 3.36 exactly. Band/step picker that cannot express 3.36 → the nearest band (3.4 on a 0.1 grid; '3.0–3.49' on a range picker). Never round to 3.5+ (the SpaceX 3.6 incident). Résumé and form must agree.
education.start_note: Entered CMU Fall 2024 (HS graduation May 2024). Year-only fields → 2024.
education.expected_graduation_full_date_rule: 2028-05-01 (1st-of-month rule when a full date is required)
education.class_standing_note: Count from the start date, never infer from the graduation year: 2024-25 freshman, 2025-26 sophomore, 2026-27 junior, 2027-28 senior.
education.transcript_note: Canonical unofficial record (cumulative QPA 3.36). Use this exact PDF for any transcript upload; never edit it.

test_scores.sat_note: Never taken. Leave SAT fields blank / 'no SAT score'. Never convert or estimate.

work_experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
work_experience.location_note: Felix's standing directive (2026-08-26): employer location on forms = Los Angeles, CA. Historical fact: the internship itself was in person in Shenzhen, China. If a form asks where HE worked rather than where the employer is based, default to LA per the directive and note it in the ledger.
work_experience.end_note: Résumé says May 2026 – Aug 2026. Whether it should read 'Present' is an open question in the vault — do not change without Felix.
work_experience.one_line: Built six production messaging-channel integrations (Discord, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Business, LINE, Zalo, Zalo Personal) on a SQLite-backed gateway, the channel onboarding flow in Next.js/TypeScript, a hybrid BM25 + dense-embedding RAG memory-retrieval pipeline, and a Dockerized LongMemEval memory-evaluation harness.

work_experience.title: Mobile Development Intern
work_experience.company: Chapman University — Gait Rehabilitation & Research Lab
work_experience.one_line: Built a cross-platform Flutter/Dart stroke-rehabilitation app: exercise rep tracking, progress-visualization charts, therapy-adherence monitoring.

work_experience.title: Machine Learning Intern
work_experience.one_line: Self-directed exploratory research into LLM-agent evaluation (LLM-as-judge rubrics, failure-mode analysis; surveyed Pydantic Evals, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval). Learning, not a shipped artifact.
work_experience.note: Removed from the résumé 2026-08-01 (Felix: light work). Enter ONLY when a form requires complete employment history; never describe it as delivered production work.

work_authorization.sponsorship_note: 'No sponsorship' is scoped to US roles only. Any non-US jurisdiction (e.g. Hong Kong) needs an employer-sponsored visa — answer 'Yes' there.
work_authorization.itar_note: US citizen → qualifies as a 'US person' for ITAR/EAR clauses (Stoke Space, SpaceX, Blue Origin class postings).
work_authorization.previously_employed_note: True only for OpenMax/COCO and Chapman University.

eeo_voluntary_self_id.veteran_status: I am not a protected veteran
eeo_voluntary_self_id.disability_status: No, I do not have a disability and have not had one in the past
eeo_voluntary_self_id.answer_policy: Answer truthfully with these values. Do NOT choose 'decline to self-identify'.

location_preferences.policy: Maximal — on any location checklist select everything / the widest option. No US location is a reason to skip a role.

availability.other_terms: Fall/Winter/Spring co-ops are applied to per triage rules; an off-cycle term would require a leave of absence — note it, don't promise it.

compensation.rules: Free-text → 'Negotiable — open to <company>'s standard intern rate'. Required numeric → the posting's published range floor (never below $20/hr); no published range → 20/hr or 40000/yr in whatever unit the field asks for (Workday strips non-digits, so 23.50 becomes 2350 — enter integers). Required band picker → lowest band consistent with ≥$20/hr.

how_did_you_hear.true_source: SWElist daily email digest, via the posting's Simplify page

languages_spoken.note: AP Chinese score 5; presented architecture plans to the OpenMax team in Chinese. Exact proficiency label not on file.

programming_languages.note: Levels as entered on Blue Origin 2026-09-01, derived from the résumé and coursework. NO years/months of experience are on file — leave duration fields blank or park; the SpaceX form incident (C++ 6–9 months, Java 10+ months) was unsupported and must not recur.
programming_languages.thin_note: C++: 15-210 (Fall 2026) is in progress; Go/Rust: on the résumé, no project or completed course in the vault. Do not claim durations or 'advanced' for these.

awards_publications.text: "SmartMeter: An Automatic Water Metering System using Computer Vision and ARIMA-Based Machine Learning", MLNLP '22 (ACM)

memberships_and_clubs.note: None documented (vault: 'CMU Buggy is a checkbox, not a role'). Answer 'none' / 'N/A'; never invent a membership.

references.note: None on file. A form that REQUIRES references parks until Felix supplies them.

constraints.never_use_cmu_email: Applications go out with felixl0808@gmail.com only (see email.email_alt_note).
constraints.never_invent: If a fact is not in this file, the answer bank, or wiki/felix-resume.md, PARK the posting and record the exact question — do not guess, infer, or embellish.
constraints.no_durations_for_languages: Never enter years/months of experience for a language or tool; none are on file.
constraints.one_packet_rule: Form fields and the attached résumé must agree (GPA, dates, counts). Check before submit.
forbidden_numbers: mem-eval 75% / 20% as a before/after improvement (they are run data on a fixed benchmark)
nDCG@k 0.95 / injected-F1 0.85 as benchmark results (they are regression gates on an 18-case set)
10-301 hw5 OCR 0.72 val error (2-epoch demo run)
'seven channels' — it is six; Telegram was 4 misc-fix commits
constraints.no_credentials_here: ATS account passwords are recorded (commented, labeled) in ~/zylos/.env and nowhere else.
constraints.wiki_fallback: wiki/felix-resume.md remains the source for any unusual question this file does not cover.
